title: Volume-Synchronized Probability of Informed Trading (VPIN), Market Volatility, and High-Frequency Liquidity
idea: Volume-Synchronized Probability of Informed Trading (VPIN), Market Volatility, and High-Frequency Liquidity (Retest as a POWER if it is about the next session's day type, yesterday's high/low, the gap, the first hour or a tail day.)
verdict: PROMISING (stress test: survived) : power 'tail_day' (base 8%): lowest-fifth days 4% vs highest-fifth 11%, Brier skill +1.2%, better than the base rate in 7/9 unseen years
